text:
toni: Noticed invoice-preview dip for 3 tenants at ~04:12 UTC. Appears during SKU rollout. Preview showed 0 then corrected a minute later.

rahul: any sample trace? my gut says route rebind + heartbeat TTL race.

toni: tenant=orchard-co, trace=`tr-orch-004`. ingest snippet:
```
2025-02-14T04:11:58Z INFO route-resolver bind sku=stable-eu -> route:r22
2025-02-14T04:12:00Z WARN quota-heartbeat ttl_expired tenant=orchard-co window=30s
2025-02-14T04:12:01Z INFO metering-event tokens=90 route=r22 fingerprint=fp-09b
```

mina: dedupe key currently `tenant|fingerprint|route_resolution_id`. If route_resolution_id flips mid-session preview dedupe treats it as new series and ordering causes transient zeros. billing finalization unaffected.

rahul: proposal: preview-only canonicalization: when same tenant+session+fingerprint sees route flip within 60s, map to canonical_preview_route (the earlier route). preview dedupe uses canonical. billing keeps strict route id.

ingest-bot: NOTICE partition-6 lag spike 04:10-04:14 consumer-lag=11s

pm-isha: product wants per-SKU preview. This keeps per-route visibility while avoiding noise. Please add console tooltip: "Preview may temporarily group route variants; invoices unaffected."

telemetry-bot: METRIC heartbeat-jitter spike 04:08-04:15 (link)

toni: action items: (1) rahul implements ingest alias map TTL=60s behind flag `preview_alias` (2) mina updates preview aggregation to resolve canonical route (3) telemetry-bot to emit `preview_alias_count` per-tenant

mina: qa: unit tests for alias map, integration test for rX->rY swaps, ensure no cross-tenant aliasing.

rahul: I'll open PR and canary to 2% tenants. Will post results here.

toni: thanks. this should reduce support noise for preview anomalies. :thumbsup:
